_about: 1-Pentanol (1) + Propionic acid (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 91.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-pentanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: M. Mohsen-Nia, M. R. Memarzadeh, Isobaric (vapour + liquid) equilibria for the (1-pentanol + propionic acid) binary mixture at (53.3 and 91.3) kPa, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 42 (2010) 1311-1315
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 6. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.41 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
